auditor_value: As served (120 m): (a) 25.0 m/s, (b) 1.67 m/s² deceleration, (c) unanswerable — the car is slowing, so it was never at rest behind the initial point.

findings.note: The question as served gives a 120 m separation, but the solution works with 60 m throughout. For 120 m in 6.00 s the mean speed is 20.0 m/s, so v₁ = 2(20.0) − 15.0 = 25.0 m/s and a = (15.0 − 25.0)/6.00 = −1.67 m/s², a deceleration; part (c) then has no answer because the car was moving faster, not slower, before the initial point. A student copying this answer loses every mark.
findings.fix: (a) 25.0 m/s, (b) 1.67 m/s² (deceleration), (c) no such point exists — the car is decelerating, so it was never at rest behind the initial point.
